opinion.summary: The inequality flip from perm[j] < perm[i] to perm[i] < perm[j] correctly fixes successor selection and explains both public failures. However the patch deletes the documented contract docstring and leaves a duplicate implementation inside an inert triple-quoted string, so it should not be merged as-is without restoring docs and removing dead code.

hypotheses.note: Buggy condition selected a smaller element instead of the smallest greater element, producing e.g. [3,1,2,4] instead of [3,4,1,2] as cited.
